role: Interface for an icon in the texture atlas: its pixel size and its u/v bounds, used by the block renderer and the GUI to emit texture coordinates.

members.name: getIconWidth
members.note: the native uv table keeps only the coordinate range, not the pixel size; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: getMinU
members.note: struct rb_uv holds min_u/max_u/min_v/max_v resolved per block/meta/side from atlas.json (render_blocks.h)

members.name: getInterpolatedU
members.note: the quad emission lerps the uv range inline; no named symbol

members.name: getIconName
members.note: names exist only in the atlas manifest used to resolve the uv table

notes: The native renderer resolves icons through render_blocks.h's atlas and table (rb_atlas, icon_index); item and HUD icons are drawn by raster_hand.c and raster_hud.c with their own uv tables. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): data structure or helper replaced by fixed arrays or inlined arithmetic (GPU contract), behavior covered by its callers. Formerly listed as missing: getIconWidth/getIconHeight have no native counterpart; the uv range alone is stored.
